limitations: Actual screen-reader speech was not captured; keyboard and accessibility semantics were checked.
Native browser zoom was checked in Chromium for ATO and four IR variants; Hunt retained its existing root-text enlargement coverage and the documented native-zoom exception.
Production identity/provider deployments and the full 20-minute all-controls ATO generation scenario are outside this UI-component qualification.
Routing implementations, HTTP clients, state ownership, form orchestration and validation are separate alignment work; existing guards and backend contracts are preserved.
